construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Block 20 of the Downtown Specific Plan covers 510 and 528 S. Mathilda (APNs 209-29-060 and -061) and 562 and 568 S. Mathilda (APNs 209-29-057 and -067). The amendments raised the block's residential allocation from 51 to 70 units and do not pre-approve the conceptual projects; each needs a Special Development Permit.

Conceptual plan for 510-528 S. Mathilda: a four- to five-story mixed-use building on 0.72 acres with 10,230 square feet of ground-floor office/commercial and 30 to 46 residential units, up to 60 feet tall. The site holds a two-story 8,883 square foot office building (1956, Mezzetta building) and an eight-unit apartment building (1950).

City records name Shawn Karimi as applicant and owner of 510 and 528 S. Mathilda (2018 and 2023 Legistar). The 2018 item names SiliconSage Builders, LLC as applicant and owner of 562 and 566 S. Mathilda; the 2022 staff report says 510 and 528 were then owned by Silicon Sage. The same staff report's allocation discussion pairs the 10,230 sq ft, 30-46 unit request with Shawn Taheri.

The state Annual Progress Report lists a 2019 application (20197303) for 54 units at 510 Mathilda under the project name SilconSage. Sunnyvale Legistar shows no Special Development Permit hearing for 510-528 S. Mathilda through 2026.
